overview_description.description:
Propeller is a global leader in drone-mapping and analytics solutions that give worksites the power to measure and manage themselves.

Headquartered in Sydney, Australia, with a North American office in Denver, USA, Propeller’s innovative hardware and software products solve real problems for real people. With visual tools everyone can use, Propeller is helping teams on thousands of worksites track, inspect, and report on job progress and productivity safely and accurately. Founded in 2014 by Francis Vierboom and Rory San Miguel, Propeller serves construction, aggregates, mining, and waste management industries globally.

about_short_description.short_description: Propeller is a global leader in drone-mapping and analytics solutions that give worksites the power to measure and manage themselves.

product.name: AeroPoints
product.description: Smart ground control points used with drones to capture survey-grade geospatial data with centimeter-level accuracy.

product.name: Propeller Platform (Map, Measure + Manage)
product.description: A cloud-based platform that processes drone and lidar survey data into interactive 3D maps for site measurement and management.

product.name: DirtMate
product.description: A GNSS receiver and dashboard system that provides real-time monitoring of machine position, progress, and productivity on worksites.

product.name: Lidar Survey Processing
product.description: A service that processes drone-captured lidar data into classified ground models and orthophotos for accurate terrain mapping.

product.name: Field Communication and Collaboration Tools
product.description: Cloud-based tools and mobile app features that enable real-time sharing of site data, safety issues, and measurements among field and office teams.
